title: Magnoflorine, a dietary alkaloid from Alpinia oxyphylla fruit, ameliorates colitis by restoring intestinal barrier and dual modulation of JAK/STAT3 pathway.
authors: Ma, Ze; Li, Xiang; Tian, Qin; Shen, Hejing; Wang, Fengzhong; Bai, Yajuan; Fan, Bei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然生物碱magnoflorine通过JAK/STAT3通路缓解结肠炎，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) management necessitates novel, diet-compatible therapeutics. Using untargeted metabolomics, we identified magnoflorine as the key anti-colitis alkaloid from the edible fruit Alpinia oxyphylla. Integrated network pharmacology, molecular docking, and a zebrafish colitis model revealed that magnoflorine directly binds to core targets including SRC and STAT3. In DSS-induced colitis, magnoflorine restored intestinal barrier integrity (upregulating ZO-1, occludin, and mucin) and rebalanced inflammatory responses (suppressing TNF-alpha and IL-6 while promoting IL-22 and defensin-1). Mechanistically, magnoflorine not only inhibited JAK/STAT3 phosphorylation but also upregulated endogenous negative regulators PTPN6 and PIAS3, revealing a dual-modulatory strategy. These findings establish magnoflorine as a promising diet-derived candidate for IBD, supporting its development as a functional food ingredient.
abstract_zh: 炎症性肠病（IBD）的管理需要新型、适合饮食的治疗方法。通过非靶向代谢组学，我们从可食用果实益智（Alpinia oxyphylla）中鉴定出木兰花碱（magnoflorine）作为关键的抗结肠炎生物碱。整合网络药理学、分子对接和斑马鱼结肠炎模型揭示，木兰花碱直接结合包括SRC和STAT3在内的核心靶点。在DSS诱导的结肠炎中，木兰花碱恢复肠道屏障完整性（上调ZO-1、occludin和黏蛋白）并重新平衡炎症反应（抑制TNF-α和IL-6，同时促进IL-22和防御素-1）。机制上，木兰花碱不仅抑制JAK/STAT3磷酸化，还上调内源性负调控因子PTPN6和PIAS3，揭示了一种双重调节策略。这些发现确立了木兰花碱作为IBD的有前景的饮食来源候选物，支持其作为功能性食品成分的开发。
